summary.intent: Fix release-please repeatedly posting duplicate self-comparing SDK changelog entries on every push to main, and track a systemic fix for the underlying preview automation bug.
summary.outcome: Immediate fix committed: removed two bogus self-compare 0.36.0 blocks from packages/sdk/CHANGELOG.md and advanced the sdk release-as pin to 0.37.0 to break the duplicate loop. Systemic fix tracked as a GSD todo.

repo: release-please-config.json has a 'release-as' pin pattern where packages are pinned to their current version — when release-as == manifest == latest tag, any releasable commit landing after the tag causes a self-comparing changelog header (v0.36.0...v0.36.0) that loops on every push.

The preview automation (.github/scripts/pr-release-preview.js) injects 'chore(release): set release targets for PR #N' commits and manages release-as pins, but only clears pins the PR itself added — pins already on main are never cleared.
8 packages currently have release-as == manifest version (api, web, core, crypto, api-client, sdk-core, sdk, crates/core, crates/fuse) — all are latent traps for the same duplicate-loop bug.

The preview script's path attribution for packageBumps (line 298, changedFiles) diverged from release-please's attribution on PR #509, leaving sdk's pin behind while release-please still counted the sdk feat commit.
separate-pull-requests is false (single aggregated release PR for the monorepo) and there is NO linked-versions or node-workspace plugin in the config.

code.finding: Pin-clearing logic only removes pins that this PR added and weren't inherited from main — inherited stale pins (release-as <= manifest) are never cleared, which is the systemic bug.
packageBumps is computed by reading changedFiles per commit — same approach as release-please but diverged on #509 for packages/sdk.

workflow: Split urgent changelog corruption fixes from systemic script hardening into separate PRs — cleanup is safe and urgent; script changes need more care.
When release-please emits a self-comparing compare link (vX...vX), the root cause is always that computed next version == current version == latest tag.
Advancing release-as to the correct next semver (manifest + bump-minor-pre-major for a feat = minor bump) is the immediate loop-breaker.

friction: The preview automation's pin-clearing gap is non-obvious — it silently leaves inherited pins in place, making the bug hard to attribute to automation vs. human edits.
Three stacked 0.36.0 headers in CHANGELOG.md (two bogus, one legitimate) required careful identification of which entries to remove without losing the real release history.
open_items: Systemic fix for pr-release-preview.js: (a) clear inherited pins already satisfied (release-as <= manifest), not just PR-added ones; (b) reconcile path attribution with release-please so sdk source changes can't leave sdk's pin behind.

Drop the 8 other stale release-as pins where release-as == manifest across api, web, core, crypto, api-client, sdk-core, crates/core, crates/fuse to prevent the same loop from triggering on those packages.
